name: Corsair Lords
description: Corsair Lords was a Puerto Rican street gang from the Bedford section of Brooklyn (Bedford-Stuyvesant), active throughout the 1950s. The gang was known for violent rivalries with neighboring Brooklyn gangs, including the Jonquils and the Brevoort Chaplains. In November 1958, a member named John Ingram, 16, was fatally stabbed during a rumble with the Jonquils in Brownsville. By 1959 the gang could field well over 100 members at a single gathering.
